A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable, complete 23-page versions of the same RILKE paper. Text and visual inspection support comparison of the main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original knowledge-editing experiments on UnKE, EditEverything and ZsRE, MMLU evaluations, ablations and routing analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains these original results, including the main benchmarks, appendix experiments and qualitative case studies.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same robust intervention objective, query-adaptive routing and shared-subspace clustering. No proposed algorithm, component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use UnKE, EditEverything, ZsRE and MMLU with the same structured and unstructured editing, paraphrase, sequential-ingestion and routing scenarios.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in reported results and case studies are unchanged. v4 removes LoRA’s description from A.3, but v3 reports no LoRA results; this deletion does not establish removal from an evaluated comparison.

E3.justification: Model backbones, edit counts, sequential and clustered evaluation procedures, metrics and settings are retained. These include the 0.001 generation temperature, 256-token latency evaluation and Table 9 configuration.

E4.justification: Both retain the robustness-loss ablation, shared-subspace and sequential-ingestion analyses, layer/radius/cluster sensitivity studies, and semantic-locality, routing-failure and edit-efficacy case studies.

E5.justification: Averaging practices and distribution reporting are unchanged. Neither version specifies repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative outputs match. For example, Table 1 retains LLaMA RILKE’s original/paraphrase BertScores of 1.000/0.963 after 1,000 UnKE edits. Table 12 retains Top-1/Top-4 precision of 0.48/0.83 for RankRAG and 0.51/0.79 for RILKE.

T1.justification: Properties 1–2, assumptions, equations and derivations are retained. A.7.2 changes gamma_j to gamma_i only in explanatory prose to match the unchanged routing-accuracy equation; epsilon glyph changes are typographic.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about precise, paraphrase-generalizable, lifelong and memory-efficient knowledge control through representation interventions.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, generalization–efficiency tradeoffs, routing ambiguity and Section 9 limitations are unchanged. The deleted A.9 concerns manuscript-writing assistance, rather than scientific interpretation or applicability.

D1.justification: Experimental implementation information remains unchanged, including Table 9 hyperparameters, EasyEdit access, Gemini-generated paraphrases and training/latency details. Removing the writing-assistance disclosure does not remove experimental reproducibility instructions.

R1.justification: v4 removes the LoRA description in A.3 and the Hu et al. (2022) reference. Other cited works and substantive positioning arguments remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited grammar, terminology, notation and footnote corrections, and replaces the nonexistent 'General Response 1' reference with 'App. A.1'. It removes the LoRA paragraph and A.9 'Usage of LLMs'; the overall narrative and section order remain stable.

P2.justification: All six figures and twelve numbered tables are retained. Appendix reflow shifts several displays, including Figure 5 and Table 10; Table 10 moves between columns on page 17. Display structures and graphical results otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves internal consistency by fixing the appendix reference, disambiguating footnotes, aligning notation and removing a LoRA description unsupported by reported results. Deleting A.9 loses transparency about writing assistance, but experimental documentation and scientific evidence are preserved. The overall gain is limited to clearer, more consistent reporting.
